install_zsh_completion: install Zsh shell tab completion for a Hydra app by delegating to BashCompletion
uninstall_zsh_completion: uninstall Zsh shell tab completion for a Hydra app by delegating to BashCompletion
query_zsh_completion: query Zsh completion options for a given config name by delegating to BashCompletion
get_zsh_help: get the install or uninstall help text with the eval command template for Zsh completion
get_zsh_exec: get the executable path string for the Zsh completion script by delegating to BashCompletion
